evidence: M-O s.v. card suit: diamonds, from Vives 1540
terms.comment: Vives’s diminutive of rhombus, the geometrical figure (Front.; Mart. Cap.); not in Lewis & Short.
Classically rue, the herb (Cic., Plin.). Traupman seems to have taken the German name of the suit, Raute, which means both a diamond shape and rue.

sources: Lewis & Short: rhombus · Lewis & Short: ruta
